requested_scene_or_action: Describe the requested scene or action
product_or_style_scope: Name the product or style scope
sample_order_or_po_reference: Use a controlled sample, order, or PO reference
production_lot_or_batch: Record the lot or batch or use TO CONFIRM
media_format: Use photo, clip, file set, or live walkthrough
actual_capture_date: Use the source capture date or TO CONFIRM
capture_time_zone: Record the time zone or TO CONFIRM
participants_or_source: Name participants or source or use TO CONFIRM
original_file_name_or_call_reference: Preserve the original filename or call reference
timestamp_cue: Record a visible timestamp or other date cue
facility_identity_or_location_cue: Record identity or location cues without assuming ownership
product_style_or_lot_cue: Record product, style, sample, order, or lot cues
approved_reference_shown: Record the approved reference shown or not shown
